cohort: The study included 70 women diagnosed with placental abruption at Basrah Maternity and Children Hospital and Al-Basrah Teaching Hospital in Basrah, Iraq.
finding: Placental abruption in Basrah is linked to late diagnosis, significant maternal complications, and poor neonatal outcomes, with contributing factors including young maternal age, anemia, obesity, and low socioeconomic status.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery predominated as the mode of birth among the studied cases (71.4%).
